dataset.availability_assumption: historical candles available at close+1ms; original publication latency/revisions not known

selection.reason: Exclude entire pre-2018-02-09 period: Binance 2018-02-08 daily candle has anomalous close timestamp; no candle repair, criterion based on integrity before modelling.

limitations: exchangeInfo is current, not point-in-time listing metadata
short history may reflect listing, requested start or provider omissions; not automatically labelled listing date
SHA256 checks content equality, not authenticity or historical revision absence
